name: Alert status
description: What this alert message is for, using the same codes as CAP 1.2 (OASIS). Never show anything but 'actual' to the public as a real warning — publishing a test or drill without this field is dangerous, which is why it's required.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Exercise
hasDefinedTerm.description: A drill. Treat it as practice, never as real.

hasDefinedTerm.name: System
hasDefinedTerm.description: A message for system or network operators, not the public.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Draft
hasDefinedTerm.description: Not sent yet — an early version.
